independence: Read-only review; reviewer did not author this startup harness.

startupSourceFindings.finding: gotoAndReady navigates with DOMContentLoaded then waits for truthy window._ftdBridge with the requested 90000 ms timeout.
The failed initial wait precedes size97 selection and worker qualification. The recorded empty rows cannot demonstrate a 97-cubed worker allocation failure.
The global accessor exists only after the app module body begins. Its captured bridge remains null until await bootBridge resolves at line531.
Explicit engine=wasm bypasses the native WebSocket probe and awaits createBridge. Initial boot is direct WASM regardless of the later Scale0 worker selection.

Initial verified-factory/module load and RenderBridge allocation do not invoke the routed _wasmCallOr sampler helper. Wave panel initialization follows the app bridge assignment. No concrete transformed function mechanism for the pre-assignment failure was identified.

One generic ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED, five successful startup route hits and no failed routed request are retained. The precise failed URL and absent-versus-null getter state are unknown. Static-module-load failure and pending direct-WASM initialization remain distinguishable possibilities, not diagnoses.

harnessChecks.detail: Identity validation hard-pins the original probe manifest, checks all 37 entries through its original verifier, and checks startup manifest files plus helper/config/server dependencies. Both variants use the original pinned installAttribution routes.

Both cases call the unchanged helper at /?engine=wasm with timeout90000, in separate ordinary Playwright contexts. No forced worker flag, lattice/scenario selection, sampler, recorder.start or scientific timing is added.

Before navigation, at DOMContentLoaded during the original wait, and after wait, snapshots record property descriptor existence/type separately from getter null/undefined/object/error. Logs retain console location, page error stack, exact failed/request/response URL and resource type, page lifecycle and dedicated worker create/close URLs.

Launcher mkdir without recursive creates a fresh run directory before Playwright startup. Reservation token/status is required by config. JSON/NDJSON/log files begin with wx where applicable; raw report and event stream are saved/flushed and attached before readiness assertions. A failed first case does not make the second serial case dependent on success.

Limits explicitly fail overflow at 20000 events, 128 workers or eight DOMContentLoaded snapshots. Snapshot evaluation has a separate five-second evidence timeout. Stream errors are reported. Tracing and snapshot work intentionally perturb startup; no acceptance timings result.

limits: This is source and byte-identity review only; no browser or test suite executed by reviewer.
Full trace and extra snapshot/event work can alter startup timing and whether a transient failure reproduces.

Worker evidence directly records observed Playwright page worker create/close events; nested pthread lifecycle/errors are not guaranteed to be fully represented. Console/page/network coverage records only events exposed through their corresponding page hooks.
The later audit-probe route is not artificially imported during startup. Missing later-route delivery is expected to remain visible, not forced to pass a six-route campaign check.
Absent or successful reproduction cannot retrospectively identify the original generic resource failure without matching evidence.
